translations.web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
translations.bsb: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment, but a man of understanding remains silent.
translations.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
